tasks.corrected_reference_answer: validate_resource accepts limit_memory (frictionless/actions/validate.py:190). Every 100000 rows it checks reported memory usage; exceeding the limit appends TaskError, marks partial, and stops the loop (295-302). This is periodic monitoring, not an allocation limit or buffer-overflow guarantee. Cross-row checks can retain growing state, and usage can exceed the threshold before the next sample.
